gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-004 directly identifies the false fixed-radius, mesh-only convergence claim: the upper endpoint tends to the finite-radius Dirichlet eigenvalue, the lower endpoint retains the Neumann truncation and exterior factor, and R must also tend to infinity for whole-space convergence.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both identify the unsupported assertion that h-refinement alone makes the finite-radius enclosure converge to the whole-space eigenvalue; finite-R truncation and the lower-bound exterior correction remain unless the radius also grows.

component_coverage.gold_component: The claimed mesh-only convergence of both finite-radius bounds to the whole-space eigenvalue is false because fixed-radius truncation and the lower-bound exterior correction remain.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly gives the fixed-R limits of both endpoints, states that finite-radius truncation prevents collapse to the whole-space eigenvalue, and specifies that R must tend to infinity as well.
